lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, with inter-blob distance increasing towards the posterior and superior regions.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting the horizontal blob rows at approximately 90-degree angles, creating a subordinate grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis on the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast light-to-shadow gradient across the horizontal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-intensity, elongated white marker or tag is visible on the upper leading edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, low-contrast teleost silhouettes are clustered around the pectoral fin and ventral-lateral gill region.
